JETMATE invoice JMFS-2600529016700 (23 Jun 2026; T7-KBI CL60, OMDW–LATI–OMDW, 18–20 May 2026; AED, TIA EUR × 4.42): TIA (handler and airport) invoice 5.2026: ground handling 470, landing 200, parking 120, passenger charge 10, security 3 + DPAC 1, border crossing 1 per pax, communication 25 = 830 EUR; Albanian VIP Transport crew transportation (departure) 102.50 EUR (incl. 20% VAT); catering 9,118.46 AED (not entered); JetMate communication 183.65, arrangement 367.30, bank 91.83 AED; disbursement 8% (on everything except arrangement and bank) 1,073.90 AED; total 14,956.79 AED. USER DECISIONS (9 Nov 2026): EUR, Albania, Europe/Tirane; single handler JETMATE; its own invoice rate 4.42 (JetMate fees AED / 4.42: 41.55 / 83.10 / 20.78); handling 470 and landing 200 only CL60, other groups empty until invoice; passenger 10, security 4, border 1 per departing pax (safe side); parking CL60 60 per started 24 h (no times, safe side); TIA and JetMate communication and arrangement in basket, bank tick; crew transportation 102.50 tick (qty box). AVIANEX invoice V/26/00265 (17 Aug 2026; P4-OWN E35L 25 t, OMDW–LATI–OMDW, 22 Jul 11:31Z – 24 Jul 07:56Z; USD): handling 3,678.54 (Euro Jet 286948TIA 3,002.67 EUR × 1.2251), supervision 200, disbursement 5% (handling only) 183.93 = 4,062.47. Euro Jet: landing 200, parking 120, passenger 10, border 1, security 4, ramp handling 470, technical handling 80, ramp transportation 30, catering 1,208 + delivery 40 (not entered), crew transportation 70, local communication 25; admin fee 11.5% of third party 259.67, ground support services 435, communication 50. USER DECISIONS: AVIANEX separate handler, all fees as Avianex's; own rate 1.2251 (supervision 163.26 EUR); handling 470, landing 200, parking (60 per started 24 h) only E35L; pax fees and communication all groups; technical handling 80 and ramp transportation 30 tick; crew transportation 70 in tick row; ground support 435 and communication 50 in basket; admin fee 11.5% on third-party items (incl. Avianex 5% disbursement = 12.075%); disbursement 5% excl. supervision; JetMate communication row shared as 'Communication Fee'. EVRO JET SERVICES SHPK invoice 3692 (25 Feb 2026; T7-KBI CL60, 20–23 Jan 2026; EUR, VAT 0): handling 470, landing 200, parking 2 × 60, lighting 140, security 4, passenger 10, border crossing 10, GAT arrival 120, GAT departure 160, catering + dishwashing 1,731 and storage 50 (not entered), crew transportation 2 × 35, document printing 20, toilet 60, water 60, communication 50, landing permit 30, permit revision 15, slot 25, supervision 200, bank 35, disbursement 5% (excl. permit, revision, slot, supervision, bank) 163.75 = 3,743.75. USER DECISIONS: EVRO JET separate handler; handling 470, landing 200, parking 60 per started 24 h only CL60; lighting airport tick; GAT arrival and departure airport in basket; per pax passenger 10, security 4, border 10; supervision, communication, permit, slot, toilet, water in basket; document printing, revision, bank, crew transportation 35 tick; storage not entered. EVRO JET invoice 4346 (19 Jun 2026; T7-AFP GL5T, 17–19 Jun 2026; EUR): handling 970, landing 400, parking 3 × 100, security 4, passenger 10, border 10, GAT 120 + 160, catering 1,843 (not entered), communication 50, crew transportation 2 × 45, document printing 15, landing permit 30, slot 25, supervision 200, bank 35, disbursement 5% (excl. crew transportation and printing) 193.35 = 4,455.35. USER DECISIONS: GL5T handling 970, landing 400, parking 100 per started 24 h; parking day count unclear (2 days for Jan 20–23, 3 days for Jun 17–19); crew transportation 45 all groups, document printing 20 all groups; disbursement on all items (incl. crew transportation and printing, safe side). TIA 2024 tariff (MTOW band; landing / base handling / parking 24 h / lighting): 15–30 t 200 / 470 / 60 / 140; 30–45 t 400 / 970 / 100 / 280; 45–60 t 550 / 1,220 / 130 / 385; security 4 per departing pax, passenger 10 per person (may include arriving pax), border 10 per departing pax. USER DECISIONS: empty groups at three handlers filled from tariff; GLEX 45.132 t → 45–60 band (safe side); lighting only at Evro Jet (by group); pax fees as on each handler's own invoice. Types from ops system (16 Nov 2026): Evropa Jet Services HANDLER (panel EVRO JET); FCG Ops Tirana Handling and Euro Jet FBO; Tirana International Airport HANDLER. JETMATE and AVIANEX not listed at LATI; FLIGHT SUPPORT by user decision. FCG QUOTATIONS (17 Nov 2026, valid to 02 Dec 2026; LATI/TIA, 07.12.2026 10:00 - 08.12.2026 10:00 UTC, 1 + 1 pax, 1 parking day; seven quotations 129017-129023, one per airframe): FCG labels the airframes by ICAO type, which crosses the panel groups - 129019 'GLEX' 43.545 t is A6-AFE (panel GL5T) and 129018 'GL6T' 45.132 t is A6-AFC (panel GLEX); AC_TAILS mapping applied. Both GL5T airframes (39.760 and 43.545 t) were quoted identically at 970, and A6-AFC at 45.132 t fell in the 45-60 band, confirming the TIA 2024 bands and the earlier 'GLEX 45.132 t -> 45-60 band' decision (the other three handlers were not restamped; each keeps its own source). Landing / handling / parking per band exactly as the panel's TIA tariff: 200/470/60, 400/970/100, 550/1220/130. FCG own fees: supervision on the apron 500, administration fee 25 (by user decision 18 Nov 2026 entered in the 'Communication Fee (TIA)' row, which TIA charges at the same 25 and which Jetmate and Avianex also pass through there; the separate flat 'Administration Fee' row created earlier that day was removed again, so the panel has 25 service rows; no amount changes, the 25 stays inside the 10% disbursement base either way), disbursement 10% on everything except supervision (disbBase allxs; reconciled to the cent: 771 x 10% = 77.10, 1,511 x 10% = 151.10, 1,941 x 10% = 194.10). Per departing pax as quoted: pax tax incl. border crossing 11.00, passenger security 4.00, other services border crossing 1.00. Communication charge free of charge, and basic ground handling includes lavatory, potable water, crew and pax transportation, conveyor belt, high loader, ACU, baggage handling, towing and pushback - all entered as 'Included'. GAT usage 150 per direction (per pax on the quotation, an on-request extra) entered in GAT Arrival and GAT Departure by user decision, as at Evro Jet; this puts the panel 330 above the quotation total (300 GAT + 10% disbursement). Quotation totals (1 day, 1 departing pax, without GAT): CL60 and E35L 1,348.10; GLF4 and GL5T 2,162.10; GLEX and GL7T 2,635.10. Type HANDLER from the ops system (FCG Ops Tirana Handling). By user decision (18 Nov 2026) 'Communication Fee (TIA)' moved to the Airport Fees section (airport, in basket, disbursable): it is the airport's own fee, unlike 'Communication Fee', which is each handler's own. No amount changes - at Jetmate (disbBase all) and Avianex (allxs) it was already inside the disbursement base, and it is empty at Evro Jet and FCG; Avianex's 11.5% admin fee refers to it by name, which is unchanged. EURO JET INTERCONTINENTAL added as a fifth handler on 19 Nov 2026 from its own quotation of that date (seven quotations, one per aircraft type, customer Falcon Aviation Services, pricing executive Maria Bodnarova). This is not the panel's EVRO JET, which is Evropa Jet Services Shpk; the ops system list of 16 Nov 2026 shows Euro Jet separately as an FBO, and that is the type entered. Mandatory services per flight, the same in every group: Euro Jet ground support services 330, communication fee 60, local station communication fee 25 (entered in the 'Communication Fee (TIA)' row, the same 25 TIA charges), technical handling 130, ramp transport 50. By MTOW band, exactly the panel's TIA 2024 tariff, which the quotation confirms: landing 200 / ramp handling 470 / parking 60 for CL60 22 t and E35L 25 t; 400 / 970 / 100 for GLF4 34 t, GL5T 40 t and the quotation's 'GLEX' 44 t; 550 / 1,220 / 130 for the quotation's 'GL6T' 46 t and GL7T 53 t. The quotation labels airframes by ICAO type, which crosses the panel groups: its 'GLEX' 44 t is a GL5T-group airframe and its 'GL6T' 46 t is what the panel keeps in the GLEX group, so the GLEX group carries 550 / 1,220 / 130, as the other handlers already do. Parking is charged per aircraft per day with the first 3 hours free, entered as free 3 in the parking object; the other handlers have no free hours. Passenger 10, passenger security 4 and border crossing 1 per departing pax, as quoted. GAT usage 120 per arriving pax and 160 per departing pax entered in the GAT rows, as at Evro Jet; the quotation's 60 per arriving and 60 per departing crew, free when the passengers use the lounge, is not entered. Permit arrangements 65 entered in the Landing Permit row. Lighting 140 appears only on the CL60 page of the quotation, so the heavier bands are filled from the TIA 2024 tariff, 280 and 385, by user decision of 19 Nov 2026. GPU 40 per hour is a new row, 'GPU (per hour)', a tick row outside the basket; the other handlers have no GPU price and show a dash. Euro Jet admin fee 8% on third party services is entered as the handler's disbursement with disbBase allxs and noDisbOn for Ground Support Services and Communication Fee, which keeps Euro Jet's own two fees out of the base; the quotation's own figures confirm the base, 875 x 8% = 70, 1,575 x 8% = 126 and 1,975 x 8% = 158, and its totals 1,335, 2,091 and 2,523 are reconciled to the cent. TECHNICAL HANDLING: the row was removed from the panel for every handler by user decision of 19 Nov 2026 and the 'GPU (per hour)' row took its place, so the panel still has 25 service rows; Avianex's 80 went with it, and the Avianex invoice of 17 Aug 2026 can therefore no longer be reproduced to the cent. Because Euro Jet's 8% base includes a technical handling 130 the panel no longer carries, the panel runs 140.40 below the quotation in every group (130 plus its 8%); the user accepted this on the basis that the service is out of both the panel and the comparison. FCG type changed from HANDLER to FBO by user decision of 19 Nov 2026. The quotation's ramp handling discount of 50% for an empty leg or techstop, hotel booking 10 per room, and the difference between these prices and what Avianex passed through in July 2026 are, by user decision, not recorded.
